craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of resort; vyabhicāri utsāha at all-embraced resort. Sanskrit-first: āśraya (RESORT — kept; resort resorts, not rests); āliṅgita-sarva (ALL-EMBRACED — kept). Rows: 9 (proof/knower/measure/world — four embraced), 1 (‘knowing’ closes — resort placed last, in knowing). Close: ‘may my mind resort to this knowing’. Rupture: comma (cut stated, then tasted — sequence cut, standing-mindedness tasted). Rejected: ‘rest’ for resort — killed: resort resorts; ‘hasten’ for quick — killed: quick kept (laghu speed). Read aloud: THEN in-HER — su-PREME, FULL, STAND-ing, en-JOY-ing — CUT-se-quence-SHORT … PROOF, know-ER, MEA-sure, WORLD en-TIRE em-BRACED — MAY-my-MIND re-SORT to-THIS-know-ING.

lines: Then in her — supreme, full, standing, enjoying — cut sequence short,
quick, taste standing-mindedness: proof, knower, measure, world entire embraced — may my mind resort to this knowing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kramaṃ vicchidyāśu sthitimatirasāt saṃvidadhati | śrayatu mama cittaṃ citim imām

reads_against.argmap: What shall the mind resort? → Sequence cut in full goddess; all embraced; mind resort prayed.
c1_essence: Sequence cut in fullness; all embraced; resort prayed.
